## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与修改结果

Describe the trigger, resulting behavior and material limits. / 说明触发条件、修改后的行为和主要限制。

## Verification / 验证

List commands actually run, results and unavailable platform coverage. Use [the testing guide](../docs/TESTING.md). / 列出实际执行的命令、结果及未覆盖的平台检查，参照[测试指南](../docs/TESTING.zh-CN.md)。

## Documentation and decisions / 文档与决策

Link the maintained guide and any owning Agent Note. Explain why a Note is unnecessary for a mechanical or local change. Review both languages before recording pair hashes. / 链接所属文档及相关决策笔记。机械或局部修改可说明无需笔记的原因。核对两种语言后再登记一致性摘要。

Target task PRs at `dev`; use validated `dev` changes for integration into `main`. / 任务 PR 面向 `dev`，验证通过后再将 `dev` 合并到 `main`。
